name: AIA Singapore
summary: Major insurer for life, health, and wealth products used by residents and expats — including Integrated Shield Plans after PR.
body: Corporate cover rarely equals complete family cover. Map inpatient, outpatient, maternity, and dental gaps explicitly while on EP. After PR, MediShield Life is automatic; an Integrated Shield Plan (ISP) is optional private top-up — compare MOH’s official ISP table, premiums payable from MediSave within limits, and riders that often need cash. AIA is one of several large brands — compare exclusions and waiting periods, not ads. Treat group schedules as employment-tied: confirm cover end dates with HR when resigning or changing jobs, and do not assume maternity or NICU sits inside a basic inpatient cap.
